name: New England Printwear
old_description: Let us assist you with ideas and solutions for your business, organization, or event. From uniforms to retail and marketing merchandise, we want to make you look good.
about:
New England Printwear operates from Plymouth, New Hampshire. The company has been producing imprinted sportswear for customers locally, regionally, and nationally for many years, drawing on over 30 years of custom sportswear sales experience. Its team comprises experienced apparel decorators with creative resources and knowledge of modern textile technology.

The shop provides a range of decoration services including screen printing with traditional spot-color plastisol and specialty inks, embroidery for headwear, outerwear, and specialty garments, and promotional product decoration covering drinkware, writing instruments, and business materials. In-house design services support clients from concept to production, and the company notes there are very few limitations on order size.

Clients span hospitality, education, non-profit fundraising, retail, community organizations, contractors, and sports and recreation. The company also operates a retail line, Panther Brand, featuring Plymouth State University and New Hampshire-themed apparel and drinkware.

New England Printwear emphasizes consistent, courteous service and on-time delivery of fairly priced, top-quality products. It acknowledges that human error can occur but works to ensure mistakes never become the customer's problem, and it highlights community outreach as a cornerstone of its business.

name: New England Stainless Steel Fabrication Inc
old_description: From custom fabrication to on-site services and system upgrades, we provide practical solutions within Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Connecticut and New Hampshire.
about:
New England Stainless Steel Fabrication Inc., known as NessFab, has operated from Weymouth, Massachusetts for over 35 years. The company is led by President and CEO Lemoy Titus and Managing Director Nicholas Titus. It began with a straightforward philosophy: do great work and treat people the right way, growing through word of mouth and repeat customers who value quality and reliability.

NessFab provides custom metal fabrication, food service equipment installation, restaurant hood and ventilation system fabrication and installation, field welding, metal refinishing, and equipment retrofitting. The shop works with stainless steel, aluminium, brass, copper, and zinc, serving commercial and industrial projects across Massachusetts, Rhode Island, Connecticut, and New Hampshire. The company also offers standard products engineered for compatibility with common appliances.

Its customer base spans food service, construction, manufacturing, healthcare, and educational institutions, including medical laboratories. Projects range from commercial kitchen installations and ventilation systems for restaurants to sterile components for healthcare labs and institutional facilities for schools.

The company emphasizes quality craftsmanship, reliability, practical problem solving, safety, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Its ventilation systems carry ISO and NSF certifications to meet health, fire, and safety codes, and field welding is performed efficiently in active environments with minimal disruption.

name: New England Table Company
old_description: We help homeowners and designers create signature spaces without mass-market compromises, building custom tables from exceptional hardwoods.
about:
New England Table Company operates from a studio in Londonderry, New Hampshire. The business was founded by Ronald Lohse, a former software engineer who turned a woodworking hobby into a full-time practice after years of building digital systems. Lohse’s first shop stood on the shore of a small New Hampshire lake, where the rhythm of hand tools and the scent of walnut rekindled a childhood memory of watching his grandfather, watercolorist Henry Lohse, build paintings layer by layer.

The company produces custom hardwood tables — dining, coffee, console, desk, and conference pieces — along with matching chairs. Each piece is built by hand in the Londonderry studio using live-edge slabs, book-matched pairs, and river-table constructions. The workflow moves from an initial conversation and digital rendering through wood selection, joinery, and hand-applied finish, with clients receiving photographic updates via a private portal. To date, more than 150 tables have been delivered.

Clients include homeowners, interior designers, and trade professionals across New England. A dedicated trade program supports designers specifying pieces for residential and light commercial projects, while the Atelier Experience offers a higher-touch commission tier in which Lohse personally sources the slab and oversees every design decision.

Lohse started the company on the conviction that furniture should be kept for generations, not replaced. That philosophy drives the Zero Waste Collection, which repurposes offcuts into smaller objects, and the practice of personally delivering and installing each table throughout the region so the maker sees the piece settle into its home.

name: New Jersey Solar Initiative
old_description: Get an instant savings estimate and see if you qualify for solar incentives.
about:
New Jersey Solar Initiative operates from Trenton, New Jersey. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. It functions as a digital platform connecting New Jersey residents with solar installation providers.

The service guides homeowners through a three-step process: submitting property details, providing energy usage data, and receiving a customized savings estimate. The platform identifies applicable state and federal incentives and matches users with local installers. No physical manufacturing or fabrication occurs on site.

The primary audience is residential property owners in New Jersey seeking to evaluate solar adoption. The company does not serve industrial or commercial clients directly, nor does it specify particular industry verticals beyond residential solar.

The company emphasizes a streamlined, no-obligation estimate process as its core value proposition. Specific differentiators such as exclusive installer partnerships or proprietary calculation methods are not detailed in available sources.

name: New Mexico Diesel Power Inc.
old_description: Complete Automotive Repair on all makes and models except European vehicles.
about:
Located in Albuquerque, New Mexico, New Mexico Diesel Power Inc. is an automotive repair shop owned and operated by Jimmy Ball. The business has been serving the area for decades, with a team that brings over 50 years of combined experience. Ball took over ownership in January of an unspecified year, continuing a legacy of diesel-focused repair.

The shop provides complete automotive repair for all makes and models except European vehicles, with a specialization in diesel engines. Services include computer diagnostics, oil changes, scheduled maintenance, and pre-purchase and post-purchase vehicle inspections. A team of three ASE-certified technicians — Jimmy, Brandon, and Andrew — perform bumper-to-bumper repairs, including electrical and computer diagnostics, using OEM parts whenever possible.

Customers range from individual vehicle owners to commercial fleets needing reliable maintenance for domestic and Asian brands, with a particular emphasis on Ford models. The technicians hold Ford certifications, including one Triple Master Technician credential from 2006, allowing the shop to serve as an alternative to dealership service departments.

The company distinguishes itself by paying technicians a salary rather than commission, aiming to eliminate pressure for unnecessary repairs. It emphasizes honest communication, extended hours for convenience, and a commitment to using high-quality replacement parts and advanced diagnostic equipment to get repairs right the first time.

name: New Mexico Manufacturing Extension Partnership (New Mexico MEP)
old_description: ﻿﻿﻿ Hear it from Clay Allison, founder and CEO of Wicked Edge, a manufacturer of precision knife-sharpening equipment with a wide range of clients — from law enforcement, to out...
about:
New Mexico Manufacturing Extension Partnership (New Mexico MEP) operates from Albuquerque, New Mexico. As the official representative of the MEP National Network in the state, it functions as a NIST MEP approved center. The organization is structured as a public-private partnership that brings together government, not-for-profit, and industry resources.

The center delivers advisory and technical services to small and mid-sized manufacturers. Its offerings include process optimization, product development, scale-up processes, lean methodologies, workforce development, growth services, efficiency improvements, quality management systems, manufacturing safety, supply chain assistance, and connection to resources. Services are provided at reduced cost through a network of resource partners.

Clients span various manufacturing sectors in New Mexico. Examples include Old Barrel Tea Company in Albuquerque, which reported a 30% increase in online sales; Los Poblanos in Los Ranchos, which saw improved output and cycle time; Wicked Edge, a precision knife-sharpening equipment maker serving law enforcement and outdoor markets; and Navajo Spirit in Gallup, producing traditional-inspired clothing. The center also collaborates with companies such as TEAM Technologies, Alaska Structures, Valencia Flour Mill, Insight Lighting, OBG Architectural Millwork, and Santa Fe Spirits.

New Mexico MEP distinguishes itself through its affiliation with the MEP National Network, which the W.E. Upjohn Institute found delivered a 13.6-to-1 return on investment in 2020. The center emphasizes hands-on assistance and technology-driven solutions to help manufacturers overcome growth barriers.

name: New Mexico School Products.
old_description: New Mexico School Products uses your blueprints and meets with you on site to plan for new or upgraded classroom layouts, seating, and storage. This is a complimentary part of our services.
about:
New Mexico School Products was founded in 1968 in Albuquerque, New Mexico. The company began as a full-coverage furniture provider for educational, government, and private institutional markets.

In 1986, the company established its own manufacturing plant, FAME Mfg., enabling in-house production of a customizable furniture line. Today, New Mexico School Products designs, builds, supplies, and installs furniture for classrooms, libraries, gymnasiums, cafeterias, and theaters. It combines its FAME product line with offerings from manufacturing partners to deliver both off-the-shelf and custom solutions. The operation includes complimentary on-site space planning using client blueprints and free ergonomic assessments for teachers and administrators.

The company serves educational institutions, government agencies, and private organizations across the United States. Projects have included schools, libraries, gymnasiums, cafeterias, and theaters. It also supplies automotive parts storage units, indicating a presence in the industrial storage market.

New Mexico School Products emphasizes quality through FAME Manufacturing’s participation in the Architectural Woodwork Institute (AWI) and Quality Certification Program (QCP). Its differentiators include complimentary space planning, ergonomic assessments, a customizable in-house product line, and a network of manufacturing partners, all backed by over 50 years of experience.

name: New Tech Metals
old_description: Development, machining, forming, welding, and finishing, all under one roof in New Franken. Real capacity, real equipment, real steel moving every shift.
about:
New Tech Metals operates from New Franken, Wisconsin, where it was founded in 1982 as New Tech Metalworks. The company is a veteran-owned, family-owned small business. Ownership passed to the Blackman family in 2003 when brothers Jeff, Keith, and David Blackman acquired the shop. Today, the second generation — Adam and Andy Blackman, both U.S. Army veterans, and their cousin Derek Blackman — own and run the operation. Adam served as a 19D Cavalry Scout and Andy as a 19K M1 Armor Crewman, experience they say informs the discipline applied to every part.

The shop provides six in-house capabilities: design and development, cutting (laser, turret punch, plasma), forming (press brakes), welding (AWS-certified across nine codes), CNC machining (milling and turning), and assembly with finishing. Equipment includes a 5-ton overhead crane, Mitsubishi fiber lasers, Strippit turret, Safan Darley press brakes, Haas VMC and EC-500 machining centers, FANUC robotic welding cells, and Haeger/Timesavers finishing systems. The facility added a 7,000-square-foot office expansion in 2012 and maintains in-house material stock. Production focuses on low- to mid-volume, high-reliability components for defense and industrial OEMs.

New Tech Metals serves three core sectors. In defense, it supplies Tier-2 components to OEMs and prime contractors for over 20 vehicle platforms, shipboard infrastructure, weapons support equipment, communications enclosures, and structural assemblies. Transportation customers include fire apparatus, refuse vehicles, concrete mixers, cargo trailers, airport ground-support equipment, and automotive programs. For machine and equipment builders, the shop produces parts for packaging equipment, paper converting, drying and curing systems, commercial appliances, power equipment, and material handling systems.

The company emphasizes that its veteran ownership brings a culture of accountability and precision that goes beyond standard quality certifications. It operates under a single ITAR-registered roof with DFARS material compliance, NIST/CMMC cybersecurity controls, and ISO 9001:2015 quality management. The owners quote jobs directly and remain accountable through delivery, offering one quote, one schedule, and one team from print to packout.

about:
New York Parts Specialists Inc operates from Long Island City, New York. The company's founding year and ownership structure are not publicly disclosed. It does business as NY Parts, focusing on supplying authentic industrial bearings and related components.

The company distributes a range of industrial products including bearings and accessories, relays, contactors, tachometers, motors and motor controls, sensors, and seals. It carries established brands such as SKF, NTN, INA (Schaeffler), and ABB. The business model centers on distribution rather than manufacturing, offering custom quotes for large industrial and OEM orders.

NY Parts serves customers in renewable energy and energy efficiency sectors, as well as broader industrial and OEM markets. The company highlights its ability to support large-scale orders with custom quoting and emphasizes fast, trackable delivery with easy returns.

The company differentiates itself through a focus on authentic parts, high-efficiency logistics, and free shipping on orders over $100. Its online resources include technical guides on bearing identification and electrical safety, reflecting a service-oriented approach to component supply.
